title: Connect Finance Church Report v1
description: One fiscal year of the real Church Report (finance_church_entries), precedence-resolved the same way production's own Church Report / Financial Health / Budget pages already resolve it: each account's own actual dollar amount, its budget amount when one has been entered (nullable -- real accounts commonly have an actual with no budget on file), and the headline income/expense/net-income totals. Real money crosses this contract, unlike the structural-only Chart of Accounts contract. This does not carry Balance Sheet data (finance_church_balances) -- that is a separate report and a separate future contract.

accounts.description: May legitimately be empty for a fiscal year with no synced or imported data yet -- that is a normal state, not an error. Includes group/header rows (hasChildren=true) alongside leaf accounts, exactly as finance_church_entries stores them; a header row's own actualCents/budgetCents almost always reads 0 (its children carry the real figures), matching production.

incomeActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Income' only -- matches production's 'Total revenue' card exactly; does not include Other Income.

incomeBudgetCents.description: Sum of budgetCents for classification 'Income' accounts that actually have one set (nulls excluded, not treated as zero).

expenseActualCents.description: Sum of actualCents for classification 'Expenses' only -- matches production's 'Total expenses' card exactly; does not include Other Expenses or Cost of Goods Sold.

expenseBudgetCents.description: Sum of budgetCents for classification 'Expenses' accounts that actually have one set.

netIncomeActualCents.description: The full reconciled bottom line: (Income - Cost of Goods Sold - Expenses) + (Other Income - Other Expenses) actuals -- matches production's 'Net income' card.

netIncomeBudgetCents.description: Same reconciliation as netIncomeActualCents, over each classification's summed budget amounts.

hasBudgetData.description: True when at least one account in this fiscal year carries a non-null budgetCents. Mirrors production's own hasBudgetData flag, which gates whether the UI shows budget columns at all.

otherIncomeCount.description: Production has real 'Other Income' rows today (confirmed 2026-09-14) -- not a theoretical classification.

otherExpenseCount.description: Production has real 'Other Expenses' rows today (confirmed 2026-09-14) -- not a theoretical classification.

costOfGoodsSoldCount.description: 0 in every real fiscal year checked so far -- this church has never posted to a Cost of Goods Sold account -- but the classification is valid QuickBooks output, not schema-forbidden.

accountsWithBudgetCount.description: Accounts with a non-null budgetCents. Confirmed 2026-09-14: this is commonly LESS than accountCount even within one winning source/year.

classification.description: Every P&L section finance_church_entries can hold. This table never carries Assets/Liabilities/Equity -- those live in the separate finance_church_balances table (Balance Sheet, a different report).

categoryPath.description: Colon-joined account path from finance_church_entries.category_path, e.g. 'Expenses:50 Program Expenses:501 Mission & Outreach'.

actualCents.description: This account's own non-cumulative actual amount for the fiscal year -- never a rolled-up subtotal.

budgetCents.description: Null when no budget was entered for this account. Genuinely common in real data; must not be assumed to always be set.

source.description: Which finance_church_entries source won this account's actual amount for this fiscal year, after resolveChurchYearPrecedence() -- a whole-year winner-take-all pick per CHURCH_SOURCE_PRIORITY, with manual_actual_override applied afterward per-account on top.
